findings.claim: The required current owner-backed GREEN proof for the repaired Deliberation integration harness is absent.
findings.observed: The supplied proof says GREEN was not run because no reachable owner revision both preserves the accepted contract and fixture hashes and implements pipelineId, intake deliveryTarget, and mode-bearing target parsing. The inherited canonical run remains exit 1 with 12 passing and 11 failing scenarios, the checkpoint leaves goal-001 incomplete, and the canonical Test Gate was not run.
findings.rationale: Goal-001 is an acceptance evidence repair whose required outcome is a successful unchanged 23-scenario cross-repository integration run against an approved contract-converged owner runtime. Owner-history inspection and a preserved RED explain the blocker but do not supply the required passing verification evidence.
findings.required: Provide an owner-approved immutable KM revision that retains the accepted owner bytes and implements the complete required runtime contract, then supply caller-owned evidence that the unchanged canonical integration command exits 0 with all 23 scenarios passing while external/live convergence remains explicitly unknown.
